g.text: Put the resistor near the D1 mini.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #34434a

g.text: All black wires join G / GND.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23373b
font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23373b

g.text: Unplug USB. On each 4-leg switch, choose two legs that are open when released and connected when pressed.

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23373b

g.text: The two unused legs can stay unwired. D5/D6 use software pull-ups; D0 needs the external 10 kΩ shown above.

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23373b

g.text: Dots = wires joined. Crossings without dots = separate wires. Colours are suggestions; follow the labels.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #637478
